# CF02 cue overlay (CF02-AUDIO)

**Status: PROVISIONAL / NOT APPROVED.** Five new Floor 1 sound effects for the COMBAT-FUN-02 (`--cf02`) rules, from the design question Q24. They are read only under `cf02_rules`; the global pack (`../../docs`, `../../cue_map.json`) is not changed.

**License/provenance:** original deterministic procedural material generated by `scripts/author_cf02_audio.py` (base seed 20261120): seeded noise and damped sinusoids, no recorded Foley, no sample, no third-party or generated-model audio, no actor's voice. No claim of expert evaluation.

| Cue id (engine) | Event id | Files | Cause |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PlayerPunchHitConfirmed` | `cf02.punch.hit_confirmed` | `sfx/cf02_punch_hit_01..03.ogg` | verified jab or haymaker hit (it no longer reuses the kick) |
| `PlayerStomp` | `cf02.carl.stomp` | `sfx/cf02_stomp_01..03.ogg` | verified stomp or dive-stomp hit |
| `EnemyWallSlam` | `cf02.enemy.wall_slam` | `sfx/cf02_wall_slam_01..03.ogg` | a kicked flier slammed into a solid |
| `BlastDetonation` | `cf02.blast.detonation` | `sfx/cf02_blast_01..03.ogg` | a dynamite charge detonates |
| `EnemyDefeatHeavy` | `cf02.enemy.defeat_heavy` | `sfx/cf02_defeat_heavy_01..03.ogg` | an enemy defeated with heavy or catastrophic force |

The design names the stomp cue `CarlStomp`; the engine id is the IP-neutral `PlayerStomp` (the event id keeps the fan-layer name, as the global pack does). Reused, with no new file: `HeavyPropCrash` (block landing), `Warning` (llama tell), `EnemyBodyCollision` (contacts and bowling), `PlayerKickSwing` and `PlayerKickHitConfirmed` (air kick, follow-through and push kick). See [`docs/03-tech/audio.md`](../../../../../docs/03-tech/audio.md) for the mapping and the rules.

## Files

- `../cue_map_cf02.json`: engine cue id to event id. `audio_events_cf02.json`: events, takes and the overlap cap. `asset_manifest_cf02.json`: sha256, duration and provenance of the 15 Ogg Vorbis files.
- `QA_REPORT.md`: structural QA (levels against the Floor 01 band, no clipping, no DC, no edge click, distinct takes). **It cannot judge how the cues sound.**
- `../previews/cf02_cues_preview.mp3`: the first take of each cue in the table's order, 0.4 s apart. A listening aid, not a runtime asset.

## Regenerate and verify

```sh
python3 scripts/author_cf02_audio.py          # rewrites sfx, manifest, events, QA report and the preview
python3 scripts/author_cf02_audio.py --check  # verifies the committed files against the manifest
```

Needs numpy, scipy and an ffmpeg with libvorbis. The Rust tests only verify the committed files.

## What not to infer

- The owner has not listened to these cues. Whether each cause is distinguishable by ear, the level against the music, and the fatigue of the stomp and the heavy defeat under repetition are open (COMBAT-FUN-02 design section 8, item 3). A sound designer may replace any file: change the right-hand side of `cue_map_cf02.json` and the event takes, nothing in code.
